summary: Build a cozy, modern, mobile-first marketing website for the coffee shop “Mookie’s at Mugford” with specific sections (hero, about, menu highlights, social proof, reviews, visit/map, footer), local SEO, and subtle animations.

existing_features.title: Create a mobile-first, single-page marketing website for the coffee shop “Mookie’s at Mugford” using the provided business information exactly as written (name, address, phone, price range, hours, service options, dog friendly, rating/review count).

Implement the specified page structure and content sections in this order: (1) Hero with headline “Your Favorite Local Coffee Spot.”, subheadline about coffee/pastries/friendly vibes, CTAs “View Menu” and “Order Online”, and visible ⭐ 4.9 rating; (2) About Mookie’s (warm, casual story mentioning community feel and dog-friendly); (3) Menu Highlights as clean cards with photos for Avocado Toast, Cinnamon Roll, Variety of Pastries, Ham, Egg & Cheese, Egg & Cheddar, Lattes & Espresso Drinks plus a “View Full Menu” button; (4) “Why People Love It” social-proof style bullets; (5) Reviews section with the three provided quotes, 5-star display, and total review count 108; (6) Visit Us with address, embedded map, hours, clickable phone number, and “Get Directions” button; (7) Footer with name/logo, address, phone, hours, and social icons (Instagram vibe).

Wire CTA behaviors with smooth scrolling and sensible fallbacks: “View Menu” scrolls to Menu Highlights; “View Full Menu” scrolls to Menu Highlights and/or expands an in-page full menu area (if implemented) without navigating away; “Get Directions” opens a maps directions URL targeting “114 Washington St, Marblehead, MA 01945”; “Order Online” opens an in-page modal or section explaining online ordering is not available yet and offers the clickable phone number to order by call.

Apply the requested brand vibe and UX polish across the page: warm cozy modern café aesthetic; soft neutrals with accent colors espresso brown, cream, muted green; subtle animations and soft shadows; smooth scrolling; clean sans-serif typography; no clutter and no pop-ups.

Implement basic local SEO for “Mookie’s at Mugford” and coffee searches: set page title/description, Open Graph/Twitter meta tags, semantic headings, and LocalBusiness JSON-LD including name, address, phone, price range, hours (as provided), and rating/review count.

Ensure performance and accessibility: optimize images (proper sizing and modern formats), lazy-load below-the-fold images, ensure sufficient color contrast, provide alt text for all images, and keep the site fast-loading.
Add and use generated static image assets by placing them in frontend/public/assets/generated and referencing them directly from the frontend (do not serve images via the backend).
